In general, pain can often help us identify when something is wrong and motivate us to make changes so that it doesn’t hurt as much next time – mentally, emotionally, spiritually. Pain helps motivate us to keep going when all we want to do is curl up and never move again and pain helps us let go when all we want to do is to never let it go. In moderate amounts, pain helps us appreciate, feel, let go, and move on. Without it, though, how would you recognize danger, differentiate hot from hotter, let go or let something move on from your body? How would you let go emotionally of something that hurt you? #No, thank you, pain can have many gifts to offer.
